title: Microservices Architecture with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud
description: Introduces microservices architecture and the Spring Cloud ecosystem for building distributed applications. Students will learn service registration and discovery, API Gateway, inter-service communication, centralized configuration, and fault-tolerance patterns through practical Spring Boot implementations.

topics.title: Microservices Architecture and Fundamentals
topics.description: Understand microservices architecture, compare monolithic and microservices-based applications, and explore the principles, benefits, challenges, and common design patterns used to build distributed systems.

topics.title: Service Registry and Discovery Using Eureka Server and Client
topics.description: Learn how microservices register themselves with a service registry and discover other services dynamically. Implement Netflix Eureka Server and Eureka Clients, explore the Eureka dashboard, and understand heartbeats and service-name-based discovery.
subtopics: Introduction to service registration and discovery
Need for service discovery in microservices
Creating and configuring a Eureka Server
Creating and configuring a Eureka Client
Calling registered services by service name
Handling service registration and discovery issues

topics.title: API Gateway Using Spring Cloud Gateway
topics.description: Understand the API Gateway pattern and implement Spring Cloud Gateway as a single entry point for client requests. Configure routes, predicates, filters, load-balanced service URIs, and cross-cutting concerns.
subtopics: Introduction to the API Gateway pattern
Need for an API Gateway in microservices
Creating and configuring a Gateway application
Integrating Gateway with Eureka service discovery
Handling cross-cutting concerns at the Gateway
Testing requests through the API Gateway

topics.title: Inter-Service Communication Using RestTemplate, WebClient and OpenFeign
topics.description: Understand how independent microservices communicate with one another. Implement HTTP communication using RestTemplate, WebClient, and OpenFeign, and explore service-name-based communication and client-side load balancing.
subtopics: Configuring service names and service URLs
Client-side load balancing using Spring Cloud LoadBalancer
Passing request headers and request bodies between services
Handling errors and responses from downstream services

topics.title: Centralized Configuration Using Spring Cloud Config
topics.description: Manage configuration for multiple microservices from a centralized location using Spring Cloud Config. Set up a Config Server and clients, use Git-backed configuration files and profiles, and refresh application properties at runtime.
subtopics: Need for externalized configuration in microservices
Creating and configuring a Config Server
Connecting the Config Server to a Git repository
Troubleshooting Config Server and client connectivity

topics.title: Fault Tolerance with Resilience4j: Circuit Breaker, Retry and Fallback
topics.description: Understand fault tolerance in distributed systems and prevent cascading failures when dependent services become unavailable. Implement Resilience4j patterns including Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback, Rate Limiter, Time Limiter, and Bulkhead.
subtopics: Introduction to fault tolerance in microservices
Understanding service failures and cascading failures
Circuit Breaker pattern and its purpose
Circuit Breaker states: CLOSED, OPEN and HALF_OPEN
Bulkhead pattern and limiting concurrent calls
Integrating Resilience4j with Spring Boot services
